informal_statement: Scale-free area of an original cap.
reason: Equivalent in the declared constructor/section context. At FourArcCandidate.lean:50-52, the source contract is `def capX : ℝ := candidate.capArea / candidate.capChord ^ 2`. The candidate constructor has 0 < h <= 1 and 0 < alpha < pi/2. CMV incidence additionally means lambda > 1 and lambda*cos(alpha) = h. These conditions are not a hidden minimality or strict-improvement assumption.
